summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K after filing a Delaware certificate of amendment to effect a 1-for-6 reverse stock split, effective 8:01 PM ET September 24, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning September 25, 2026 on Nasdaq. The board acted to regain compliance with the Nasdaq Capital Market minimum bid price requirement, relying on stockholder authorization from the May 27, 2026 annual meeting. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions round up. The ticker KITT and a new CUSIP 63911H504 apply. Options, warrants and convertibles adjust proportionally; ownership percentages and voting power remain virtually unchanged. This is a routine capital-structure maintenance event, not a special situation.
